main.title: Dock and search

settings.description: Move page dots left or right from the centered position.

settings.description: Number of app columns in the drawer grid.

settings.description: Scale app drawer icons relative to the stock size.

main.title: Task carousel

settings.title: Modify carousel
settings.description: Enable custom task carousel spacing, opacity, blur, tint, and icon offsets.
settings.categoryDescription: Spacing, scale, opacity and blur.

settings.description: Additional horizontal spacing between recent task cards.

settings.description: Smallest task scale used while the carousel is away from center.

settings.description: Lowest card opacity used by side tasks in the carousel.

settings.description: Allow blur to render outside each task card bounds.

settings.description: Opacity of the tint overlay applied to task cards.

settings.description: Vertical offset for the app icon shown over each task card.

settings.description: Enable a fixed overall scale multiplier for task cards.

settings.description: Vertical spacing below the bottom Clear All button.

settings.description: Handle width as a percentage of the available bottom area.

settings.description: Visual thickness of the gesture handle.

settings.description: Horizontal position adjustment for the handle.

settings.title: Y offset
settings.description: Vertical position adjustment for the handle.

settings.title: Reserved area
settings.description: Bottom inset reserved for the gesture handle surface.

settings.title: System gesture area
settings.description: Gesture capture zone height reported to the system.

settings.title: Hide on launcher
settings.description: Auto-hide the handle while Pixel Launcher is visible.
settings.categoryDescription: Hide rules for launcher, apps and lock screen.

settings.title: Hide delay on launcher
settings.description: Delay before hiding the handle on the launcher surface.

settings.title: Hide in apps
settings.description: Auto-hide the handle while regular apps are visible.

settings.title: Hide delay in apps
settings.description: Delay before hiding the handle while an app is foregrounded.

settings.title: Hide on lock screen
settings.description: Keep the gesture handle hidden on the lock screen.

settings.title: Remove reserved area
settings.description: Let content use the bottom area normally reserved for the gesture handle.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Visible handle opacity when it is shown.
settings.categoryDescription: Opacity, fade timing and custom color.

settings.title: Fade-in animation
settings.description: Duration of the handle show animation.

settings.title: Fade-out animation
settings.description: Duration of the handle hide animation.

settings.title: Set color
settings.description: Use a custom color instead of the system gesture handle color.

settings.title: Bar color
settings.description: Color used when custom gesture handle tinting is enabled.
